evidence: We carried out top-view scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) measurements to investigate the morphology of the ALD SnO2 films. X-ray photoelectron spectra (XPS) of a 15 nm thick Au-supported ALD SnO2 film show no signal of the underlying Au. The flatband potential of our ALD SnO2 layers was measured using electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS). We carried out electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and Hall-effect studies for clarification of the rectifying nature of the SnO2/[Fe(CN)6]3+/4+ contact. We used cyclic voltammetry (CV) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. We carried out Hall measurements.
